import numpy as np, base64, json, os, math, random

# Helper to make base64 PCM int16 string

def b64_pcm(x):
    x = np.clip(x, -1.0, 1.0)
    pcm = (x * 32767.0).astype(np.int16)
    return base64.b64encode(pcm.tobytes()).decode('ascii')

# Single-cycle waves length 32 samples, tuned so C-4 at 261 Hz when played at C-4
N = 32
# Square 25% duty
sq25 = np.concatenate([np.ones(N//4), -np.ones(N - N//4)])
# Square 50%
sq50 = np.concatenate([np.ones(N//2), -np.ones(N - N//2)])
# Saw
saw = np.linspace(-1, 1, N, endpoint=False)
# Triangle
tri = 2*np.abs(2*(np.arange(N)/N) - 1) - 1

# Drum synthesis
sr = 8363  # base for C-4 speed; drums one-shot not necessarily tuned

def kick_drum(dur=0.22, f0=80.0, f1=40.0):
    t = np.linspace(0, dur, int(sr*dur), endpoint=False)
    # expo decay freq sweep
    k = (np.log(f1) - np.log(f0)) / dur
    f = np.exp(np.log(f0) + k * t)
    phase = 2*np.pi*np.cumsum(f)/sr
    env = np.exp(-t*18.0)
    click = 0.3*np.exp(-t*1200.0)
    sig = 0.95*np.sin(phase) * env + click
    # slight soft clip
    sig = np.tanh(1.2*sig)
    # tail down
    sig *= np.hanning(len(sig))
    return sig

def noise(n):
    return np.random.uniform(-1,1,size=n)

def snare(dur=0.2):
    n = int(sr*dur)
    t = np.linspace(0, dur, n, endpoint=False)
    # body tone
    body = np.sin(2*np.pi*180*t) * np.exp(-t*25.0)
    # noise with bandpass-ish filter (simple IIR)
    white = noise(n)
    # simple HP filter then exponential decay
    hp = np.zeros(n)
    x1 = 0.0
    for i in range(n):
        x = white[i]
        hp[i] = 0.9*(hp[i-1] if i>0 else 0.0) + (x - x1)
        x1 = x
    env = np.exp(-t*40.0)
    sig = 0.5*hp*env + 0.9*body
    sig *= np.hanning(n)
    return sig

def hihat_closed(dur=0.035):
    n = int(sr*dur)
    t = np.linspace(0, dur, n, endpoint=False)
    white = noise(n)
    # metallic via ringmix of multiple oscillators
    osc_freqs = [5000, 7610, 8630, 9500]
    metal = sum(np.sign(np.sin(2*np.pi*f*t)) for f in osc_freqs)
    sig = 0.35*white + 0.15*metal
    env = np.exp(-t*180.0)
    sig = sig*env
    sig *= np.hanning(n)
    return sig

def hihat_open(dur=0.18):
    n = int(sr*dur)
    t = np.linspace(0, dur, n, endpoint=False)
    white = noise(n)
    osc_freqs = [5000, 7610, 8630, 9500]
    metal = sum(np.sign(np.sin(2*np.pi*f*t)) for f in osc_freqs)
    sig = 0.25*white + 0.25*metal
    env = np.exp(-t*18.0)
    sig = sig*env
    sig *= np.hanning(n)
    return sig
